meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会分析你 Fork 的 NanoClaw 定制,生成可重放迁移指南,再在干净上游上重放,完成升级且不产生合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你要求把 Fork 的 NanoClaw 升级或迁移到上游新版时触发;会先检查当前改动,再按流程提取定制并生成指南。

say.text: 帮我把这个 NanoClaw 更新到上游最新版
say.note: 开始分析改动并生成迁移指南

say.text: 迁移指南已经有了,直接开始升级
say.note: 跳过提取,按已有指南重新应用定制

say.text: 帮我看下我 Fork 里改了什么再升级
say.note: 先提取定制,再执行迁移

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes your customizations in a forked NanoClaw, creates a replayable migration guide, then checks out clean upstream code and reapplies your customizations from the guide, upgrading without merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to upgrade or migrate your forked NanoClaw to upstream. It first checks the working tree and asks how to handle existing changes.

say_en.text: Update this NanoClaw fork to the latest upstream version
say_en.note: Starts analyzing changes and building a migration guide.

say_en.text: I already have a migration guide, just do the upgrade
say_en.note: Skips extraction and reapplies from the existing guide.

say_en.text: Check what I changed in my fork, then upgrade
say_en.note: Extracts customizations first, then runs the migration.
